Thread,Ⓒs.ⒹsUtraM, taMtuH, (fig. also), (ASA-taMtuH), guRaH, taMtraM; ‘t(hread) of a story’ kaTAprabaMDaH-anubaMDaH-saMdarBaH-anvayaH, anu-, saMDAnaM, prabaMDArTaH; ‘t(hread)-bare’ sUtradaridra; ayaM pawaH sUtradaridratAM gataH (Mr. 2), sUtraSeza; jarjara.

Ⓝ[Thread]y,Ⓒa.ⒹsUtra-taMtu-maya (yI f.).

Threat,Ⓒs.ⒹtarjanaM, tarjitaM, BartsanaM, apakAragir f.
Ⓝ[Threat]en,Ⓒv. t.ⒹsaM-, tarj 1 P, 10 A, nir-, Barts 10 A, BI c.
Ⓔv. i.ⒹpratyA-sad 1 P, lagna.

Ⓝ[Threat]ening,Ⓒa.ⒹBartsatakft; anizwAvedin; pratyAsannamaya, viBIzaka.
Ⓝ[Threat]eningly,Ⓒadv.Ⓓtarjayat a.

Three,Ⓒa.Ⓓtri (tisf f.); ‘aggregate of t(hree)’ trayaM, tritayaM, trikaM, trayI; ‘t(hree) months’ trimAsaM, mAsatrayaM; ‘two or t(hree)’ dvitra, tri-catura, &c.; ‘t(hree)-cornered’ trikoRa; ‘t(hree)-eyed’ trilocanaH, trinayanaH; &c.; ‘t(hree)-fold’ triguRa; ‘t(hree)-fourths’ tripAdaH, pAda-trayaM; ‘2 and t(hree)-fourths’ pAdonatrayaM.
ⓃThird,Ⓒa.ⒹtftIya.
Ⓔs.ⒹtftIyaBAgaH-aMSaH.
Ⓝ[Third]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹtftIyasTAne.
ⓃThrice,Ⓒadv.ⒹtriH, trivAraM.

Thresh,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓmfd 9 P, pari-, pU 9 U, nistu-zIkf 8 U, kaMq 10.

 2 taq 10, pra-hf 1 P.

Threshold,Ⓒs.ⒹdehalI, dvArapiMqI, grahAvagrahaRI; (fig.) prAraMBaH.

Ⓝ[Thrift]y,Ⓒa.Ⓓmitavyayin, alpavyaya; See Frugal.

Thrill,Ⓒs.Ⓓpra-, kaMpaH, sPuraRaM, harzaH; (of joy, horror, &c.) romAMcaH, pulakaH; udDarzaH; ‘t(hrill) of joy’ harzaromAMcaH, pulakodgamaH, romaharzaH, ‘a t(hrill) came over her body’ tasyA gAtraM romAMcitaM-pulakitaM-kaMwakitaM-baBUva; ‘with a t(hrill) of horror’ sADvasaromAMcitagAtraH.
Ⓔv.ⒹsPur 6 P, hfz 4 P, pra-, kaMp 1 A; gen. ex. by pulakrita, romAMcita, kaMwakita, (a.); ‘he t(hrill)ed with joy’ AnaMdapulakitatanurbaBUva.
Ⓝ[Thrill]ing,Ⓒa.Ⓓlo(ro)maharzaRa (RI f.), pulakita, romAMcita, &c.

Ⓝ[Thriv]ing,Ⓒa.ⒹvarDizRu, pra-upa-cIyamAna, samfdDa.

Throat,Ⓒs.ⒹkaMWaH, galaH, kfkaH, nigaraRaH; ‘relating to t(hroat)’ kaMWya; ‘up to the t(hroat)’ AkaMWaM, AkaMWAt.

Throb,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓpra-, spaMd 1 A, sPur 6 P, vep 1 A; kaMp 1 A.
Ⓝ[Throb]bing,Ⓒs.ⒹspaMdaH, spaMdanaM; sPuraRaM, sPuritaM, kaMpaH.
Throe,Ⓒs.ⒹyAtanA, vedanA, vyaTA; (of delivery) prasavavedanA, prasavakAlavyaTA.

Throne,Ⓒs.ⒹsiMhAsanaM, nfpAsanaM, &c.; BadrAsanaM; ‘ascended the ancestral t(hrone)’ Beje pEtf-kamAsanaM (R. xvii. 28); ‘getting the t(hrone)’ rAjapadAvApti f.; ‘having lost his t(hrone)’ CatraBrazwaH.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹaBizic 6 P, rAjye aBizic, siMhAsanaM Aruh c.; ‘t(hron)ed king’ aBizikto rAjA.

Throng,Ⓒs.ⒹjanasaMmardaH-saMkulaM, lokanivahaH.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹA-samA-kF 6 P, saMbAD 1 A.
Ⓔv. i.ⒹjanAkIrRa-janasaMbADa a. BU; See Crowd.
Ⓝ[Throng]ed,Ⓒa.ⒹA-samA-kIrRa, janasaMkula-saMbADita.
Throttle,Ⓒv. t.ⒹgalaM nizpIq 10, galanizpI-qanena vyA-pad c., galahastayati (D.).

Through,Ⓒprep.ⒹEx. by instr. or abl.

 2 maDyena, aMtareRa; ‘t(hrough) the branches’ viwa pAMtareRa.
Ⓑ

Ⓑ

Throw,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓpra-, kzip 6 P, pra-, as 4 P, pat c., pra-, muc 6 P, visfj 6 P, Ir c. prez c., (with loc. of place); ‘t(hrow) a glance’ dfzwiM-cakzuH-kzip or dA 3 U or pat c.; ‘t(hrow) into disorder’ piMjalI-AkulI-kf 8 U, vyUhaM BaMj 7 P; ‘t(hrow) dice’ akzAn Avap 1 P or pat c.
Ⓝ[Throw] about,Ⓐut-vi-kzip, ita-stataH cal c.; bAhUtkzepaM ‘t(hrow)ing about the arms’.
Ⓝ[Throw] away,ⒶniH-vi-kzip, apAs, [] apa-hA 3 P, apavyaD 4 P, tyaj 1 P; (time) kzip, hf 1 P, yA^1 c. (yApayati^2).

 2 niH-, sf c., apAs.
Ⓑ

Ⓝ[Throw] up,Ⓐudas, utkzip &c.; (from the stomach) udvam 1 P, ud-gF 6 P; ‘I have thrown a wall around’ upakzipto mayA BittibaMDaH (M. 5).
Ⓔs.Ⓓpra-, kzepaH-paRaM, prAsanaM, preraRaM; &c.
Ⓝ[Throw]er,Ⓒs.Ⓓkzeptf m., prAsakaH.
